W.basis: Visible upper roof/back cornice silhouette, alpha>220 contour; endpoints with increasing x. Approximate common architectural direction, not proof all fine edges are collinear.

D.basis: Visible upper roof/back cornice silhouette in the other ground direction; endpoints with increasing x. Approximate +/-2 px endpoint selection.

heightReference.basis: Manually selected front main-wall vertical from base contact to main cornice, excludes rooftop housings and the recessed top volume. Approximate +/-12 px.

supportEnvelope.basis: Manual visible support extremities including facade footings and attached planters/balconies in front projection; asymmetric logical placement envelope, not a claim of three exact rectangle corners. Rear support is hidden and only parallelogram closure is inferred. Approximate +/-8 px.

notes: Original tool PNG preserved byte-for-byte in source and runtime copies; no programmatic masking, warping, recoloring or background removal.
crop is the half-open source pixel bbox of alpha>8; low-value exterior alpha is suppressed only by the existing display cache.
The support envelope is ground-centered for placement; rear corner is inferred, not measured.
The two selected roof axes are mapped at render time to +/-0.5, with vertical edges kept vertical. This does not recover a physical 3D camera or guarantee every drawn roof edge.
targetHeight=2 is the main-wall visual scale; rooftop details rise beyond the chosen reference and remain part of visual acceptance.
